understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (up/down/left/right) move the currently selected piece one grid step (with positions given in pixel coordinates, 3 pixels per cell). Walls ('#') act as solid obstacles that can prevent movement, while pushable blocks ('B') can be pushed if they are directly adjacent in the movement direction and there is space for them to slide. When multiple selectable pieces are present, control is switched using CLICK on the exact pixel coordinate of the target selectable; only the currently selected piece (shown as 'P' in the semantic grid) responds to movement.
